items.title: Chuck Findley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 6, 2023
items.q: And we did the “Trilogy” album for Frank Sinatra, when I did that you know there was — nothing was uptight. It was all — we were making great music for Frank

ctx.x: Okay. I got a little ping on my — I don’t know what they want now. Anyhow no, it was fun, it was great, working in Louie Bellson’s big band when I first moved to town, you know it was just wonderful. It was like playing in another club. Doing a session was like playing in a club. And we did the “Trilogy” album for Frank Sinatra, when I did that you know there was — nothing was uptight. It was all — we were making great music for Frank and Frank did one take and that’s it. You know? It wasn’t like twelve takes.…

It sounds like you’re describing a situation that there was so much work and so many good musicians but it was not competitive. Like how come they called that guy for this gig instead of me but that wasn’t a necessary thing that happened at the time.
